summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP), introduced by Anthropic in November 2024, has become the de facto open standard for connecting AI agents to external tools, data sources, and services over a shared protocol. By 2026, registries like mcpservers.org track over 9,800 servers, and the ecosystem spans individual servers (GitHub, Playwright), aggregator platforms that bundle hundreds of integrations, and gateways that handle auth and routing. MCP matters because it lets AI agents securely act on real systems — repos, databases, browsers, design files — without bespoke integration code for every tool.
ecosystem_note: Individual MCP servers expose a single tool or service (e.g. GitHub, Playwright), aggregators bundle and manage many servers behind one connection with unified auth (e.g. Composio, Smithery), and gateways/proxies sit in front of servers to handle authentication, routing, and security (e.g. agentgateway, Cloudflare MCP).

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Repositories, issues, pull requests, code search, and GitHub Actions
tools.pricing_paid: Included with GitHub plans; GitHub Team/Enterprise for advanced features
strengths: Low maintenance burden with managed gateway
tools.best_for: Teams automating code review, issues, PRs, and repo workflows with AI agents

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation and control (Chrome/Chrome for Testing)
strengths: De facto standard for agent browser control
Enables web scraping, testing, and navigation
tools.best_for: Agents that need to browse, test, or automate web interfaces

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 250+ integrations including GitHub, Slack, Gmail, Linear, Notion with managed OAuth
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based and team plans for higher volume and production use
strengths: Managed OAuth eliminates manual token handling
Unified auth across hundreds of tools
tools.best_for: Developers building AI agents that need many pre-authenticated integrations fast

tools.name: Filesystem MCP
tools.connects_to: Scoped local file access — read, write, and search files
strengths: Nearly universal in local agent setups
tools.best_for: Agents that need controlled access to a local project directory

tools.name: PostgreSQL MCP
tools.connects_to: Read-only (and optionally write) SQL database queries against Postgres/SQLite
strengths: Enables agents to inspect and query production/dev data safely
tools.best_for: Agents that need to answer questions over relational data or inspect schemas

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Registry of thousands of MCP servers with one-click install and hosting
tools.pricing_paid: Paid hosting/team tiers for private and scaled deployments
strengths: Largest MCP server registry and discovery hub
tools.best_for: Discovering, installing, and hosting MCP servers without local setup

tools.name: Figma MCP
tools.connects_to: Design files, frames, and components for design-to-code workflows
tools.pricing_paid: Requires a Figma plan; Dev Mode features on paid tiers
strengths: Popular with front-end and full-stack teams
tools.best_for: Generating UI code and extracting design context from Figma files

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP
tools.connects_to: Hosted remote MCP servers with OAuth, plus Cloudflare Workers/KV/D1 tooling
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans for higher usage and production deployments
strengths: First-class remote MCP hosting on Workers
Eliminates local install and credential leakage
Scales in CI and production environments
tools.best_for: Deploying and securing remote MCP servers at the edge

tools.name: Sentry MCP
tools.connects_to: Error monitoring, issues, traces, and performance data
tools.pricing_paid: Sentry paid plans for higher event volume and team features
strengths: Lets agents triage and debug production errors
tools.best_for: Agents that investigate and resolve application errors and incidents

tools.name: Supabase MCP
tools.connects_to: Postgres database, auth, storage, and edge functions on Supabase projects
tools.pricing_paid: Supabase Pro and team plans for scaled projects
strengths: Popular with full-stack and indie developers
Works in CI without local credentials
tools.best_for: Agents managing full-stack backends and databases on Supabase

tools.name: n8n MCP
tools.connects_to: Workflow automation across 400+ apps via n8n nodes and triggers
tools.pricing_paid: n8n Cloud and Enterprise plans for hosted/scaled automation
strengths: Exposes n8n's huge automation library to agents
Bridges AI agents with existing workflow stacks
tools.best_for: Agents that trigger or orchestrate multi-app automation workflows

tools.name: Docker MCP
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP servers via Docker MCP Catalog and Toolkit with isolated execution
tools.pricing_paid: Docker Pro/Team/Business plans for advanced features
strengths: Secure, isolated server execution in containers
Curated MCP Catalog of verified servers
tools.best_for: Running MCP servers in sandboxed, reproducible container environments

tools.name: Stripe MCP
tools.connects_to: Payments, customers, invoices, and subscription data via Stripe API
strengths: Lets agents build and query payment flows
Works in CI without local keys
tools.best_for: Agents that build or inspect payments and billing logic
